trimmedBy: node trim-sources-04-captures.mjs (JSON.parse, whole-record selection, regex redaction of e-mail addresses and separator-bearing phone numbers inside string values, JSON.stringify); never a byte cut
notes: The endpoint answers ONE unparameterised JSON ARRAY, not an envelope: 39 records, no page, count or cursor field of any kind, and the `allow` response header is "GET, HEAD, OPTIONS". There is therefore no pagination to drive and no server-side filter was sent (one plain GET, owner-approved 2026-11-19); the seeded config's `categories` is matched CLIENT-SIDE against `category_name`. Every record carries exactly eight STRING fields: url, title, description, company_name, category_name, tags, location, pub_date. `category_name` is Title Case ("Development", 39 records split across 8 categories), so the seeded lower-case "development" matches only case-insensitively. `tags` is ONE comma-separated string, not an array. `pub_date` is an OFFSET-bearing local instant ("2026-11-19T03:05:06-05:00"), never a bare date or a UTC Z. `url` is the redirect shape https://www.workingnomads.com/job/go/<id>/ and the trailing numeric segment is the only identity the payload carries; there is no id field. `location` is a free-text display string ("Anywhere in the world", "CET (+/- 3 hours)"), with no country code, so remoteness is not asserted from it. No field names a salary, a deadline or an application address. Kept 6 whole records (both shortest Development ones plus one of each other category, so the fixture exercises the category match AND the non-match) out of 39; the array shape is as received. Terms of Service (committed byte for byte beside this file as terms.html.txt, read 2026-10-24): no clause on automated access, scraping, an API or reuse of listings, either way; clauses 2.2 ("intended purpose"), 3.1(b) (no commercial exploitation of the Service) and 3.1(d) (no competitive product) are the ones the owner's 2026-11-16 ACCEPT_RISK decision knowingly accepts. robots.txt allows everything, which is silence rather than a grant. No attribution obligation is stated anywhere in the terms or the response. Every `creator` object (the only field naming a human) was dropped by key. E-mail addresses and phone numbers inside string values were replaced by a parser; personal NAMES in free-text descriptions cannot be found by a parser and were not redacted (records were chosen with short descriptions to limit exposure).
